author: vladimirwoxi
description: Split-screen co-op for Little Nightmares (2017) Enhanced Edition by vladimirwoxi: two players on one PC, two gamepads, one half of the screen each. Not online. Made by vladimirwoxi, not by us.

needs: Your own copy of Little Nightmares (2017) Enhanced Edition. The mod was tested on one non-Steam copy only; a Steam copy may not work.
Two XInput gamepads connected to the same PC, before the game starts.
steps: Press Install. The launcher puts the UE4SS mod loader and the mod next to Atlas-Win64-Shipping.exe.
Plug in both gamepads, then press Launch.
Co-op is on from the start: the second player appears at the main menu and the screen splits in two. A row in the main menu turns it off and on.
tips: This is split-screen on one PC. There is no online play.
It is a prototype tested in windowed mode only. Known problems: both players grabbing the same hook can crash the game, and a closing door can leave player 2 behind.
If the players have swapped gamepads, restart the game.

launch.hint: Plug in both gamepads before the game starts. The second player appears at the main menu.
